data.content_ref: inline:The reliability gain from 'inter-rater convergence' in SRC_002 is compatible with the 'externalized memory' mechanism in SRC_004, as both shift the reliability bottleneck from individual cognitive recall to a shared procedural framework. This relation is refuted if convergence on counter-intuitive variables (SRC_002) occurs without the use of the checklist's externalized prompts (SRC_004).
